title: What happens when the primary account holder turns 25
summary: This document explains the transition when the primary account holder approaches age 24 (in preparation for turning 25): the system prompts you around age 24 to prepare for the next account type. If “Yes” is True, the account automatically moves to an eligible adult checking option at 24 with no action; if “Yes” is False, you must choose a new account type and complete a simple upgrade process at 24. It also instructs customers to review adult account options now and keep contact information current to receive transition notices.
